title: One peer can evict every authenticated DIO issuance
description: Security codereview finding in python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py: accept_authenticated_dio stores opaque fan-out capabilities in one global OrderedDict capped at MAX_AUTHENTICATED_DIO_ISSUANCES, then evicts oldest entries without a per-signer quota. Unlike verified receipts, a single authenticated peer can sequentially send and have 64 fresh DIOs admitted, consuming each receipt and evicting all still-live DIO evidence from other peers before routing/time/SCHC consumers elevate it. Add a bounded per-signer issuance quota/fair eviction (or supersede only that signer's older equivalent evidence) and regress that one-peer flooding cannot invalidate another peer's live issuance.
